bayts.text: Our master Aḥmad, the beloved of the Sender, has surpassed all the prophets and messengers.
He Who made him journey by night (Qurʾān 17:1) has set Aḥmad before the noble ones, with the reverence of all.
The degree of the servant, the Messenger Aḥmad, has made the elect radiant and praiseworthy.
The Prophet, on the day of “Am I not (your Lord)?” (Qurʾān 7:172), bestowed the answer upon the radiant ones, and all answered rightly.
Our Aḥmad, whose loftiness is everlasting, has left every father and mother powerless (to beget his like).
The signs of Aḥmad have encompassed the signs of those who have passed and of whoever will come, and have surpassed this age.
His Book has encompassed the Books of the messengers of the One Who sends down (the Revelation), and has bestowed hospitality and the banquet.
Muḥammad — upon him the most excellent peace — is set foremost by the best of deed and word.
The beginning of al-Māḥī (Muḥammad) is the end (reached by) the elect: the Lord of choice has preferred him above the creatures.
Every master who is chosen has testified that Aḥmad is the Chosen One.
All that is other than him yields to the Chosen One; (every good) has fled to him by grace, and he has encompassed it.
Our Messenger has surpassed all the messengers and the prophets, and he is the beloved of the Sender.
